stance_rationale: The optimizer draft is a design protocol, not a verifiable optimizer package: weights.csv is absent, the requested alpha_scores.parquet and covariance.parquet artifacts are absent, and hard constraints cannot be audited at schedule level. The most fragile claim is that future Forge assertions can substitute for a multi-date weights schedule and actual cost, turnover, CVaR, TDC, and constraint evidence under AX-002.

critical_concerns.description: Required optimizer artifact weights.csv is absent from qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260517_001, so n_names, max_w, sum_w, long-only, turnover, cost, and walk-forward schedule checks cannot be performed.
critical_concerns.ax_cite: AX-002; AX-008; RF-O5; RF-O6; RF-O7; RF-O9; RF-O13

critical_concerns.description: Declared stage artifact dir A qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_001 does not exist, and dir B has design documents but no alpha_scores.parquet or covariance.parquet. The requested time-series alpha and PSD/cond≤100 covariance checks are therefore impossible.
Stage 3 clamp followed by Stage 4 normalize is acknowledged as non-idempotent; allowing violation_rate ≤ 1% is not equivalent to hard weight_bounds [0,0.20] and sum_w=1 for every emitted row.

Method selection is not an honest completed net_ir comparison: DPL is preselected as production, while B1-B6 are future post-hoc baselines. This leaves RF-O10 open despite candidates_tried=7 being under the cap.

Iter-specific alignment is not cleared: alpha SubStab/confidence is pending, risk Hill alpha is pending, and CRISIS small-sample handling lacks optimizer-level boundary shrink to max_w 0.10 plus cash sleeve.
Cost and turnover are not measured; the draft says estimated_cost is Forge-pending and uses ambiguous 15bps × turnover language instead of proving the role-prompt round-trip proportionality check.

Liquidity compliance remains inherited but unproven: upstream context documents a 5e7 KRW feature-build universe while the hard mandate is 20d TV ≥ 2e8 KRW, and no final selected-name ADV audit exists.
Sequential Admission evidence is absent: no TDC vs PG2/MEGA_05, replacement scenario, integration scenario, or blended 80/20 SR/MDD/IR is reported.
No optimizer_challenge_note.md exists for this WT, and infeasibility_report_status='NOT_TRIGGERED at design phase' is premature because no actual weights, CVaR, or hard-constraint checks have run.
The draft relies on expected HHI, expected sector non-binding behavior, and typical Gumbel sharpness; these are assumptions, not optimizer evidence for a KR top-20 long-only schedule.

supporting_arguments: The draft is transparent that it is design_phase_a and documents Forge obligations rather than silently hiding missing metrics.
candidates_tried=7 is within the ≤10 cap, and the package names net_ir as the intended objective.
The design docs explicitly warn about projection non-idempotency and require future per-sig_date assertions.
unresolved_disputes: Whether discovery_design_phase_a is a formally accepted Charter §10 subclass or only a proposed governance exception.
Whether Stage 3/4 max-3 iterative projection can achieve zero hard-constraint violations rather than ≤1% violations.
Whether DPL production weights may be selected before B1_MVO/HRP/ERC/CVaR/MaxDiv/EW net_ir comparison is complete.
Whether turnover is one-way or round-trip in the cost model.
Whether final liquidity filtering will enforce 2e8 KRW ADV rather than the wider 5e7 feature-build universe.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that a design-only DPL projection spec plus future Forge mandates can stand in for an actual multi-sig_date weights.csv proving hard constraints, turnover, cost, CVaR, and sequential-admission evidence.
rebuttal_required: Emit qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260517_001/weights.csv with as_of_date × ticker × weight × method_selected and at least 60 sig_dates.
For every as_of_date, prove n_names≤20, 0≤w_i≤0.20, sum_w=1±1e-6, long-only, and no cap re-violation after normalization.
Emit alpha_scores.parquet and covariance.parquet at the declared WT-D20260517_001 artifact path, including covariance PSD and post-shrink cond≤100 checks.
Emit realized turnover_annual, cost using the role-prompt proportionality convention, net_ir, and RF-O2/RF-O13 disposition.
Emit optimizer_comparison_summary with DPL vs B1-B6 net_ir/MDD/CAGR/turnover and a non-retrospective selection rule.
Emit CVaR/Hill alpha results and an infeasibility_report if any CVaR or hard-constraint breach occurs.
Emit TDC vs PG2/MEGA_05 plus replacement and integration scenario metrics.
Emit optimizer_challenge_note.md with explicit No Silent Override disposition.
rationalization_red_flags: "Stage 1 ReLU + Stage 2 Gumbel suppression + cross-section Z-score sufficient"
"NOT_TRIGGERED at design phase" for infeasibility despite no emitted weights
"Phase 4 deferred" for Dykstra projection, Σ-quadratic variance penalty, and HHI regularization

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Only a self-authored design package exists for optimizer. Forge and Architect evidence are absent, and alpha/risk artifacts remain Forge-pending; no two-source PASS exists.
